setup.title: Connect to Home Assistant
setup.lead: Enter your Home Assistant address. You'll log in on its own sign-in page; this app never sees your password.
setup.badUrl: That doesn't look like an address. Try something like 192.168.1.10:8123.
setup.unreachable: Can't reach {{url}}. Check the address and port, and that this device is on the same network.

errors.cannotConnect: Home Assistant didn't accept the connection. Is it running?
errors.invalidAuth: The login expired or was rejected. Log in again.
errors.httpsToHttp: This page is on HTTPS but Home Assistant is on HTTP; the browser blocks that. Open this app over HTTP, or give Home Assistant HTTPS.
errors.authCallback: The login didn't complete. Try again.

edit.title: Arrange the home screen
edit.hint: Drag a card by its handle to move it; tap its size to change it.
